title: Road to Hana Luxury Limo-Van Tour with Helicopter Flight
overview: Travel the famous Road to Hana in style, enjoying a luxurious small-group sightseeing road trip by Limo-Van and a stunning helicopter flight back, during this 6-hour adventure. Sit back and relax inside your plush Limo-Van on the way to Hana, stopping at the Hawaiian hamlet of Ke’anae, and at a gorgeous waterfall, where you’ll have time to swim (conditions permitting ). You’ll also enjoy a beachside lunch before eventually boarding a helicopter for an incredible 36-minute flight above Haleakala Crater and the island’s rugged coast. This luxurious small-group trip to Hana also includes a professional guide.
itineraryStops: Hana Highway - Road to Hana (Pass By)
inclusions: 6-hour Luxury Limo-Van Road to Hana Tour
36-minute Eco-Star helicopter flight with live commentary
Pacific Rim Cuisine Lunch and ice-cold beverages
Professional, Hawai'i State Certified Driver / Guide
Entrance Fee Included to Wai'anapanapa State Park - Hana's Famous Black Sand Beach
The listed price does not include a $24 parking fee, payable at the time of tour check-in.
Overweight fee - Please read Weight Restrictions

title: Complete Island 60-Minute Helicopter Tour
overview: Maui is an island that’s best seen by air, and on this complete island Maui helicopter tour, visitors soar above valleys and waterfalls that are otherwise inaccessible. Fly deep inside the West Maui Mountains where there aren’t even any trails, and gaze upon the colorful cinder cones of Haleakala Crater. Off the coast of Hana, watch as waterfalls tumble their way directly into the sea, and see hidden coves and white sand beaches you never even knew were there.
itineraryStops: Hana Highway - Road to Hana (Pass By)
inclusions: 60 minute flight of East and West Maui

title: West Maui and Molokai 60-Minute Helicopter Tour
overview: This Maui helicopter tour is packed with jaw-dropping sights, from waterfalls tumbling through hidden valleys to the tallest sea cliffs of Earth. During this Maui helicopter tour of the West Maui Mountains and Molokai, visitors will soar above mist shrouded ridgelines that are covered in native ferns, and get bird’s eye views of parts of the island that are only accessible by air. Crane your neck up as a 1,100-foot (335-meter) waterfall spills all the way down towards the sea, or casually look down as the blue Pacific rolls right underneath your feet.
inclusions: 60-minute flight over West Maui and Molokai

title: Hana Rainforest Helicopter Flight with Landing from Maui
overview: Drink in the lush beauty of Maui’s Hana Rainforest and northern shores from the air on a scenic helicopter flight, including a stop at the Wailua Valley. Glide over the jungle-clad north coast, passing beauty spots like the ‘Jaws’ surf break beach and Jurassic Rock. Then, land in an untouched spot in the verdant Wailua Valley, stepping out to explore the tropical vegetation and admire views over waterfalls and canyons before your return flight.
itineraryStops: Hana Highway - Road to Hana (Pass By)

title: Epic Waterfall Adventure, the Best of Maui
overview: Discover the beauty of Maui’s waterfalls during a half-day tour. Meet your guide at a departure point for a small-group excursion that includes several waterfalls and optional cliff jumping. Go for a hike and admire views during the journey to reach the waterfalls. Swim, sunbathe, and jump off rocks during this adventurous tour. Go pro photography and videography are available for interested groups.

title: Haleakala Classic Vehicle Sunrise Tour with Breakfast
overview: See sunrise from the top of Maui’s highest volcano during this informative tour of Haleakala National Park. Climb aboard an air-conditioned vehicle for a scenic tour of the dormant volcano and crater of Haleakala and the upcountry area. Learn about the culture, history, and geology of Maui during the trip. After sunrise, visit the historic towns of Makawao and breakfast in Pa’ia.
inclusions: Helly Hansen Windbreaker Suit Top & Bottom
This is NOT a bike tour
Please bring your own Water and Snacks

title: Waterfall Hike and Kayak Snorkel & Paddle from Makena
overview: This Maui kayaking and snorkel tour is a chance to experience the best of both worlds by pairing snorkeling with hiking! Kayak and snorkel off South Maui and the historic Makena coastline, before taking a guided, cultural hike through ancient Hawaiian ruins. This combo tour is the perfect way to experience the Maui outdoors, and a great way to explore the island—by land as well as by sea.
inclusions: Beach side safety and paddling instruction from our guides
Quality late model ocean touring kayaks
Hike Supplies: back pack, rain poncho, insect repellent,

title: Molokini Snorkel and Performance Sail from Ma'alaea Harbor
overview: Sail aboard a catamaran to Molokini crater, one of Maui’s best snorkel sites. The volcanic atoll off the south coast is a natural marine preserve, home to 250 species of tropical fish. Join the crew at the helm of “Paragon II” as Maui’s afternoon trade winds get the boat to this top destination.
inclusions: Light breakfast with fresh, local coffee
Sail Maui provides complimentary reef safe sunscreen

title: Te Au Moana Luau at The Wailea Beach Marriott Resort on Maui, Hawaii
overview: Participate in a traditional Hawaiian luau during your time in Maui and learn about the Polynesian ancestry of the islands. Watch dancers portray the stories of fishing, gathering, and voyaging in “Te Au Moana: The Ocean Tide”. After your pre-show entertainment, a delicious dinner is served at your table in a three-course family-style meal, with a fire knife performance.
inclusions: Traditional Hawaiian luau meal served in three courses tableside
Receive fresh flower lei (subject to availability), kukui nut lei or carved wooden necklace
Featuring the dances of Polynesia, live music, concluding with a spectacular fire knife performance!
Valet parking available for $55. Self-parking is free, validation required if exiting after 8:30pm.
Souvenir photos (available to purchase online from Blinnk Photography)

title: VIP Private Road to Hana Tour with Pick Up
overview: See the best of Maui on this customizable, private Road to Hana adventure, where the day unfolds at your pace. Stop at stunning spots like Pua'a Ka'a, Wai'anapanapa State Park, Ke‘anae Point, Upper Waikani Falls, and Koki Beach, with time to explore volcanic beaches, waterfalls, and dramatic coastal views. Along the way, soak up the rich culture and history of Hawaii, with highlights like the charming town of Hana, serene Hamoa Beach, and the breathtaking Waimoku Falls.

title: West Maui and Molokai Special 45-Minute Helicopter Tour
overview: On this exclusive helicopter tour of Maui, soar past valleys and hidden waterfalls that are inaccessible by land, and hover above ridgelines that sit at the heart of the rugged West Maui mountains. Cross the channel to neighboring Molokai, where vertical sea cliffs spill 4,000 feet to the turbid shoreline below, and get up-close views of a part of the world that has barely been touch by man.
inclusions: 45 minute flight over West Maui and Molokai

title: Molokini Crater Snorkeling Adventure
overview: The offshore crater of Molokini has some of the best snorkeling spots in Maui—if you can reach them. Thankfully, this half-day snorkeling tour heads straight for Molokini and Turtle Town nearby on a 53-foot (16 meters) Lani Kai II boat with a 20-foot (6 meters) waterslide. Visit two snorkeling locations, get the chance to spot whales, and enjoy onboard breakfast and lunch. Whales sightings are seasonal in nature, from November through April.
inclusions: Full face snorkel masks are not allowed

title: Old Lahaina Luau Maui
overview: Soak up Hawaiian history and culture at the 3-hour Old Lahaina Luau in Maui. Enjoy hula dancing, an oceanfront setting and fresh island fillets, as well as other traditional dishes. You'll be greeted with a Hawaiian lei and tropical drink from the bar before settling in for a lively performance against the Maui sunset.
inclusions: Fresh flower lei, tropical drink and souvenir program on arrival
Hotel pick up and drop off

title: Doors Off West Maui and Molokai 45 minute Helicopter Tour
overview: Soar above scenic Maui and Molokai on this unforgettable ‘doors off’ helicopter flight. Feel the island breeze in your hair as you enjoy the only doors-off helicopter flight on Maui, gliding above scenic vistas of towering waterfalls, sparkling rainbows, and unspoiled valleys thick with rainforest.
inclusions: Flight recording on USB available for purchase

title: Helicopter Tour of Molokai and Maui
overview: Soar above two scenic Hawaiian Islands on a helicopter tour of Maui and Molokai from Kahalui. Watch surfers riding Maui’s breaking waves as you fly towards Molokai’s sheer coastal cliffs, capture aerial images of Kahiwa Falls and the isolated North Shore, then turn towards the emerald green Halawa Valley. Watch for whales and dolphins as you cross Pailolo channel, swoop over Maui’s lush rainforest canopy and explore Iao Valley State Park, then enjoy views of Honokohau Falls and Haleakala volcano on your return flight to Kahalui.

title: Haleakala Maui Sunset Twilight Tour with Dinner
overview: Many travelers summit Haleakala for the sunrise but you can beat the crowds by visiting for an equally scenic sunset instead. Enjoy the best sunset view on Maui from the island's tallest peak. .
inclusions: Tour narration by a professional driver/guide
Pick-up and drop-off at specific Maui hotels

title: Feast at Mokapu Luau in Wailea
overview: Indulge in a delicious feast and Hawaiian culture during the Mokapu Luau at the Andaz Maui. Take your seat on the grassy lawn and watch performers as they take you through Hawaiian history and the Polynesian culture that has created the island. Enjoy a delicious plated, ohana-style meal as well as unlimited handcrafted cocktails while you watch the performance.

title: Maui Whale Watch & Snorkel from Ma'alaea Harbor Pride of Maui
overview: Join the Pride of Maui for a premium whale watching and snorkeling experience aboard Maui's largest and most stable Maxi Power Catamaran. With 360-degree panoramic views, snorkeling at a vibrant coral reef, and a full barbecue lunch, this half-day tour offers memories that last a lifetime. Enjoy spacious decks, first-class service, and amenities like a water slide, warm showers, and snorkeling gear provided for all guests. Whale sightings are guaranteed.
inclusions: Parking fee $2 USD per hour. payment should be made by credit card only
